project.name: BlitzMath
project.summary: Live maths battles for classrooms and families: a teacher or parent hosts, children join with a six-digit code on their own device, and everyone answers the same questions at the same time. No accounts, no ads, no chat.
project.availability: Free to play. Not part of the for-sale catalogue.
project.privacy: No accounts and no id for a device or a person. A child's progress stays on the child's device; a room and its nicknames are deleted when the game is over.
notes: One Durable Object per game room holds the questions, the clock and the scores, so the server is the referee and nothing can be faked from a child's device.
English, German, French and Italian. Practice for the Swiss Gymnasium entrance exams: 17 skills after 6th class and 18 skills after Sek.
Parents' packs with Stripe checkout and licence codes are built and not yet on sale.
